screen10.text: Screen 10 · Kids: homework, routines, Mega Bucks

screen10defaults.text:
Defaults to confirm
• Homework: a parent photographs the sheet in their own chat; MEGA (Muse Spark, image input) writes 3–5 new questions at the kid's level.
• Kids get hints (a guiding question), never the answer.
• Parents get a summary card and choose how many Mega Bucks to release (practice 5, chore 3 by default). Only Admin and Partner can release.
• Bedtime prep reads tomorrow's household events; the morning routine is 4 steps set by a parent.
• The chore push uses the Screen 6 kid push (54pt buttons, quiet hours).

screen11defaults.text:
Defaults to confirm
• Reached from the kid's own room (Store button with the balance).
• Free from the start: bed, desk, lamp, rug, and the 6 shell colors on offer today. Store-only: other furniture (4–8), stickers (5), new colors (10), antennas (12), eye colors (10), anime eyes (15). Prices are config.
• Eyes (owner, Oct 27): eye colors (Pink, Gold, Mint, Lilac, Ember) recolor the standard eyes in every face (open, happy, wink, closed). One pair of anime eyes was made with Muse Image and downscaled to the visor; it swaps only the resting eyes.
• Colors, antennas and eyes are tried on live on the kid's own MEGA before buying (real sprite engine).
• Bought furniture lands in the Decorate tray marked NEW.
• Posters stay free and out of the Store (made with Muse Image) — confirmed by the owner, Oct 27.
• Adults don't have a Store (their MEGA looks stay free).

screen12defaults.text:
Defaults to confirm
• Two layers: Household (everyone) and Only you (private, dashed, lock). Partner's view never shows Admin's Dentist.
• MEGA may suggest sharing; only the owner's tap shares.
• Hub checks household events only. The Dentist overlapping soccer practice is never flagged (the negative control).
• A clash gets one fix, labelled as from Hub (AI), with before/after. Admin approves clash fixes (owner, Oct 27); nothing changes until then.
• Gift ideas use only shared info; products come from web search (G4).

screen9defaults.text:
Owner feedback, Oct 28 (all applied here)
• No empty band above MEGA: Hub stands in a spotlight and the brand block is centered above the buttons, which sit in the thumb zone (Reddit, Brink and Once on Mobbin).
• The sheet offers Apple and Google first, then email + password with Show and Forgot password (Polarsteps, Fiverr, Cal AI). Make my MEGA opens it on Create account.
• Loading is never blank: your MEGA paces back and forth on “Opening chats”, centered.
• Invite: the paste field and Continue sit right under the instructions, with an example link under the field (Discord). Until the G8 camera build, the QR card is a “No link yet?” help card.
• Adults and kids get different invite screens, chosen from the invite. Admin makes each person’s MEGA when inviting; adults keep or change it (Flighty-style personal invite), kids can’t change it at join and a grown-up types the parent code.

screen13.text: Screen 13 · Onboarding chat (sign up → name → integrations)

screen13defaults.text:
Defaults to confirm
• Flow (owner, Oct 28): sign up → chat opens → "What should I call you?" → integrations one at a time → family steps (Screen 5).
• Your MEGA starts with a default look; tap its badge in the chat header to customize it (Profile).
• Gmail first, read-only (gmail.readonly). Google shows an "unverified app" warning while the app is in testing; only listed test users can connect, and access lapses after 7 days until re-consent.
• Calendar: Google Calendar (calendar.readonly) or this phone's calendar (expo-calendar, already in the build). Then .ics links from schools and teams.
• Everything found lands on YOUR private calendar. MEGA may suggest sharing; only your tap shares.
• Each card has Not now; skipping never blocks the next step. Everything is also in Settings later.
• Demo uses a synthetic Gmail account with made-up school, dentist and bill emails (hackathon rule: synthetic data only).

screen14defaults.text:
Defaults to confirm
• Search cards show the answer and tappable sources (title + site). Kids get kid sizes and at most 3 kid-safe sources.
• A rephrased kid search says so above the answer; a blocked one shows only "I can't look that up. Ask a grown-up." and searches nothing.
• Parents see only blocked and changed searches (Family → kid → Searches), when "Tell me about blocked searches" is on.
• Weather: Open-Meteo forecast for a saved place; NWS alerts on top, colored by severity. Only Severe/Extreme alerts push.
• Travel: "Leave by" uses Mapbox traffic between saved places, same words as the leave-by push. Without a Mapbox key the card says travel time isn't set up and never guesses.
• Places are household data, edited by adults; kids read-only. MEGA never uses the phone's location.
• Sample places are public landmarks; Home is a placeholder address.

screen15defaults.text:
Defaults to confirm
• Gift ideas show up to 2 real products each (picture, price, store, Open) from a product catalog. No picture from the store → the pixel gift box. Store names and pictures here are made-up stand-ins.
• MEGA only searches and reads prices. It never buys; Open goes to the store.
• Price drops: MEGA watches items added to a gift list and tells Admin and Partner when one gets cheaper. The birthday kid never gets it.
• Not set up → honest copy and web links without prices; never a guessed price.
• UV (max today, with the WHO level word) and US AQI (EPA level word, short form) sit on the weather card, colored ok / warn / danger. A tip goes out when UV ≥ 8 during an event, or AQI > 100 during an outdoor event; AQI over 150 is a normal push, everything else quiet. Sample numbers are summer values (late-October UV is low).
• Holidays come from a public-holiday calendar. The evening before, MEGA asks a parent once whether to pause routines and chores; the kids hear it at bedtime. School closures still come from the school's .ics link.

screen16.text: Screen 16 · Accounts, HQ and profile pages

screen16defaults.text:
Defaults to confirm
• Connected accounts lists each source with a status dot (Connected / Needs you to sign in again / Couldn't check lately), what it reads as, and when it last checked. Schedule links show the site, never the full link (it can carry a private token).
• Testing mode: Google asks again every 7 days. MEGA posts one Reconnect card in your chat and the Settings row turns gold; nothing is read until you reconnect.
• Disconnect asks first, then stops reading and removes what MEGA found. Anything you already shared stays shared.
• Google not set up: the Gmail card says so with only Not now (no button that can't work); the calendar card still offers this phone's calendar.
• Found items and imported calendars land on YOUR private calendar; MEGA may suggest sharing, only your tap shares. Removing a found item leaves a one-line "Removed" note.
• Rules and limits: parents edit a kid's quiet hours, buzzes a day, web search, homework mode, blocked topics and what parents hear; safety concerns are always on. The kid sees the same page read-only.
• Activity: each action shows who decided (Rule, MEGA (AI) or You) and why; What it learned has Forget. The Gmail address, school and team links are made-up stand-ins.
